notes: Build your own chat overlays in Settings -> Stream overlays, with a live preview, a green dot for overlays open in OBS and a test message. Plus a new square Top 10 leaderboard overlay.
Raid Back: turn on Raid in Currently LIVE and the people who raided you move to the top.
TikTok viewer count next to Twitch's (right-click it to combine them), and a Following tab with everyone you follow who's live.
Reunion's chat says who removed a message or person. Click Reauthorize Twitch once (Settings -> Connections) to turn it on.
Better chat: Twitch name colours, tidier grouped messages, TikTok @usernames and chat history. Settings has a sidebar and search.
